summary.text: David Hawk is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 5, where he has served since 2002, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Hawk is on the ballot with Catherine Bacon.

paragraphs.text: David Hawk attended Tusculum College and earned a BBA in marketing from East Tennessee State University in 1990.
In 2006 he attended the Senior Executive Program for State and Local Government at Harvard University's John F. Kennedy School of Government.
Hawk worked as a salesman for Tailor Shop Men's Clothing from 1985 to 1990 and has been its vice president of clothing sales since 1990.
He has represented District 5 in the Tennessee House since 2002.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Finance, Ways, and Means, Health, and Pensions and Insurance committees.
